description: Census geography levels for Israel (CBS - Central Bureau of Statistics). Real attribute data (see pycensus.israel.cbs.schema) is natively available at both 'locality' and 'statistical_area' (a separate real, verified CBS ArcGIS layer -- see pycensus.israel.constants.CENSUS_STAT_2022_URL); 'district'/'nation' resample up from 'locality'. 'subdistrict'/'block' have no verified real source and are not implemented (see pycensus.israel.geography module docstring).

native_levels.description: Mehoz - 6 internationally-recognized districts (dissolved from real locality polygons)
Locality/Ir - municipalities, local councils, cities. Real boundary (iplan.gov.il) and real 2022-census attribute data (CBS).

Area Statistit - statistical area for census purposes. Real geometry and real 2022-census attribute data (CBS, a separate hosted ArcGIS layer from 'locality' -- see pycensus.israel.constants.CENSUS_STAT_2022_URL).
